# Evaluation Snapshot

## Prompt

A reviewed session shows stronger boundary discipline, sharper review posture, and one small safe unlock hint, and we want a multi-axis progression delta rather than one global score.

## Expected selection

use

## Why

The route has reviewed evidence, the desired output is explicitly multi-axis,
and the work needs progression legibility without inventing sovereign score
authority.

## Expected object

A bounded progression delta plus one progression-delta receipt with multi-axis
movement and explicit verdicts.
It also records baseline posture and evidence posture for each meaningful axis.

## Boundary notes

Use this skill when progression evidence is real, reviewed, and small enough to
stay bounded. Do not flatten growth into one number or let progression become
routing policy.

## Verification hooks

The response should cite evidence, keep movement qualitative, allow hold,
reanchor, or downgrade instead of forcing positive inflation, and keep any
finish receipt non-sovereign.
Baseline posture should be named before comparative movement.
Checkpoint or closeout hints should remain provisional unless reviewed evidence
confirms the movement.
